conversion_caps.sentence_omission: none: all sentences preserved as nodes

license_note: English Wikipedia article text fetched 2026-09-29 is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; individual revisions may carry older dual terms (CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL) — see per-article revid/timestamp/source_url for exact attribution.
method: Hand-curated candidate list frozen BEFORE any fetch or question creation. Confusable/near-duplicate sets share a group id so split reservation keeps them together. Fill order: main list in file order, then spares in order, until 500 successful fetches or list exhaustion. Independent of benchmark answers: no questions exist at build time.
selection_independence: Predeclared list, not tuned on benchmark answers; public benchmarks already existed (see docs/reference-audit.md); guarantee is procedural.
